=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:86-87 (same text in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:95-96) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Find the entries while planning (Procedure 2)" and "Tick only after the step is confirmed" bullets name the highest-id entry comment as authoritative but never tell the session to read every page of the tracker's comments, although `load_entry_comments` in scripts/operator_step_issue.py (271-283) uses `gh api --paginate --slurp ...?per_page=100`.
  WHY: On a tracker with more than one page of comments, a first-page-only read picks a stale comment or none, so the wrong comment gets ticked or the right one is missed. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5, gpt-6-luna and glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT, and gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it MAJOR. The highest is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Read every page of the tracker's comments, as the pipeline does, before choosing the highest-id entry comment."
  expected_change_site: .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md, "Find the entries while planning (Procedure 2)" bullet, plus the required-phrase list in tests/test_deploy_activate_command.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The manual instruction bullet in both command copies omits the read-every-page instruction, and the test suite does not require it.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md (identical text in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md), "## Human-Steps Issue" bullets "Find the entries while planning (Procedure 2)" and "Tick only after the step is confirmed" | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Both bullets call the highest-id entry comment authoritative and tell the session to list the key's comments again, but neither says to read every page. `load_entry_comments` in scripts/operator_step_issue.py (line 271-273) uses `gh api --paginate --slurp ...?per_page=100`.
  WHY: On a tracker with more than 100 comments, a session that reads only the first page picks a stale comment or finds none, and ticks a comment the pipeline's `tick` and `upsert` no longer treat as newest. The effect is a missed or misplaced tick, not a corrupted tracker.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: add "Read every page of the tracker's comments, as the pipeline does, before choosing the highest-id entry comment." to the bullet in both copies, and add that phrase to the `required` tuple in tests/test_deploy_activate_command.py (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md, "Find the entries while planning (Procedure 2)" bullet | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The instructions for finding the authoritative entry comment do not mention that the pipeline helper reads all pages of the tracker's comments.
  WHY: `load_entry_comments` in `scripts/operator_step_issue.py` uses `gh api --paginate`. On a tracker with many comments, the operator or AI session might see only the first page, pick a stale comment or miss the latest one, and tick incorrectly.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md, "Find the entries while planning (Procedure 2)" bullet | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Same as above for the template copy.
  WHY: This can lead to stale or missing entry comments.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: "Read every page of the tracker's comments, as the pipeline does, before choosing the highest-id entry comment."
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md, "Find the entries while planning (Procedure 2)" bullet
  Evidence of absence: The diff adds the human-steps issue text to the new `.md` files but omits the explicit instruction to read every page of the tracker's comments from the manual instruction bullet. The test suite also misses this requirement.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md, Human-Steps Issue, "Find the entries while planning" and "Tick only after the step is confirmed" (live lines 86–87; template lines 95–96) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The procedure requires selecting the highest-ID pipeline-authored entry comment but does not tell the session to read every page of tracker comments.
  WHY: A first-page-only read can omit the latest entry comment once the tracker exceeds the page limit, so the command can miss the entry or act on a stale comment. `scripts/operator_step_issue.py` fetches all pages before selecting the authoritative comment (lines 271–283, 376–390).
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md (same text in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md), "## Human-Steps Issue" bullets "Find the entries while planning (Procedure 2)" and "Tick only after the step is confirmed" | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The command names the highest-id entry comment written by the pipeline account as authoritative and tells the session to re-list the key's comments, but never says to read every page. `load_entry_comments` (scripts/operator_step_issue.py:271-283) reads all pages with `gh api --paginate --slurp ...?per_page=100`.
  WHY: On a tracker with more than one page of comments, a first-page-only session picks a stale comment or reports nothing to tick, and edits a comment the pipeline no longer reads while the real newest entry comment stays unticked. Both bullets still carry this gap in both copies.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: add "read every page of the tracker's comments, as the pipeline does" to both bullets in both copies, and add the phrase to the required list in tests/test_deploy_activate_command.py (~4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
